book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Sambatay aadhdhidaappe guye saaminttafe koyro gallas buro saloy zo7ishin Magdale Maaramanne hankko Maarama duufoza beyana bida.
Qoppontta dishin gita biitta qaaththi hanides; Godaa kiitanchchayka saloppe wodhdhi duufaakko biidi shuchchaa genderisidi iza bolla uttides.
Kiitanchchazas medhay wolqqanththa poo7o mala; iza may7oyka shachcha mala booththa.
Duufo naagizayti kiitanchchazas babbi kokkoridinne hayqeth misatida.
Kiitanchchazi maccassata, «Babbofte; intte kaqettida Yesusa koyzayssa ta erays; izi ha7i haan baa; izi kase yootida mala hayqoppe dendides; haa yiidi izi ichchidaso be7ite.
Ha7ikka eleli biidi iza kaallizaytas, ‹Hayqoppe dendides. Inttefe kasetidi Galila bees; intte iza heen demmana› giidi yootite. Hi7a ta inttes yootadis» gides.
Maccassatikka baboninne ufayssan kumidi iza kaallizaytas yootanaas elelidi woththan duufozi dizaso yeggi aggidi bida.
Heerakka Yesusi istta demmidi, «Haytoo saro» gides. Isttika Yesusaakko shiiqidinne iza toho oykkidi izas goynnida.
Yesusi istta, «Babbofte! Biidinne istti Galila baana mala ta ishatas yootite. Istti tana heen beyana» gides.
Maccasati buro oge bolla dishin naagizaytappe baggati katamaa biidi hanidayssa ubbaa qeeseta halaqatas yootida.
Qeeseta halaqatikka dere cimatara shiiqettidi zorettida; wottadaratas gidiza miish immidi, « ‹Nuni dhiskon dishin iza kaallizayti qammara yiidi kaysoti efida› gite gida.
Hayssi worey dere haarizayssa matan siyettikokka nuni izas lo7eththi yootana; aykko iitaykka intte bolla gakkontta mala nu ooththana» gida.
Wottadaratikka miishshaa ekkidi istti gida mala ooththida; hayssi yo7ozi hach gakkanaas Ayhudata achchan daroson yootettishe dees.
Hessafe guye Yesusa kaalliza tammanne issineti Yesusi istta bessida Galilan diza zuma bolla kezida.
Yesusa be7ida mala izas goynnida; istta garsafe guuxxiza baggati sidhida.

Yesusikka bana kaallizaytakko shiiqidi, «Saloninne sa7an godateththi taas imettides. Hessa gishshas biidi dere ubbaa Aawaa, Naazanne Xillo Ayana sunththan xammaqishe, tana kaallizayta ooththite; ta inttena azazidayssa ubbaa naagana mala tamaarsite. Tanikka alame wurseth gakkanaas inttenara days» gides.

footnotes.text: Sambata Hayssa bolla Sambatay Qeera gallassa.
